description: Land Acquisition -  Wadukkodde - East, Valikamum  West D/S Division, Jaffna District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a land acquisition notice under Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically describes the acquisition of a particular land parcel (Lot No. 01, Uluthollai) in Jaffna District for a public purpose, including details about the property location, extent (0.0969 Hectares), and claimants. The content primarily deals with land acquisition matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative actions.
